caption: The drawing consists of three objects against a plain light background. The upper left object is a circular, tan, and brown shape with scalloped edges, containing swirling and chevron-like carved patterns. Adjacent to it on the upper right is another circular form, featuring multiple radial segments resembling flower petals, all converging at a central, slightly raised dot; this object is rendered in similar tan and brown tones. Below these two shapes, centrally positioned, is a vertically oriented shield-like object with a small cross-shaped handle on top. The body of this object is oval, filled with an interlocking cube pattern in various shades of brown and tan. The objects are neatly spaced, and the artist's name, "R.R. Miller," is written in small brown letters in the lower right corner of the composition.
title: Three Details of Confessional
